line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.1.3: Removed unneeded variable (no need to get starting option answers)
* on-screen notification clutter settings
* player's Non-aggression pacts (Add-Ons 2.0.2: and pre-coalition reputation)
* *** faction tables
* on/off; with this setting factions can tell their defense fleets to properly focus on threats which don't officially claim sectors (like the OCV or Khaak Queens)
* -1=full defense ; 0=cautious ; 1=baseline (vanilla Mayhem 3) ; 2=confident ; 3=reckless
* wants to make peace and will also offer it to the player
* 0= default ignore Terraformers ; 1=fear them and desire the global alliance ; 2=Galactic Protector ; 3= Tyrant
* how many freighters factions had before last cycle
* how many freighters factions lost during last cycle
* NPC workers pathing around enemy/blacklisted sectors
* conquering living space away from the OCV portal
* how many complaints a faction has about player's boarding actions
* Ultimatums ZH 2.0 - contains an array for each race which can contain two elements. 1) sector that the faction demands from the player 2) gametime when they sent the ultimatum
* Coordinated Invasions
* OCV hunting rearguard fleets
* list of who declared war on player in the past
* The whitelist is shared.
* ZH 2.0 - always inform player about whats going on with Phanon
* Handle the player separately.
* global alliance status
* Terracorp's secret Xenon progress goals before they are willing to declare a global alliance
* Add-Ons 2.2: Scaling is always 100%.
* Zero Hour 2.0
* ** ZH 2.0 - removed extra OCV starter ships
* update relations so that main empires don't care about neutral Traders. Add-Ons 2.0.2: NEVER write directly back to GetCompanies since the variable is retrieved from memory.
* It's patched now, but this is a dangerous write.
* Expanded 2.2: Just call Mayhem.GetMainFactions, which has commonwealth + Yaki, Phanon, and Player.
* Companies now references Private Corp.
* E-War, Zero Hour changes to Hacking system
* ZH 1.7, advanced galaxy states, requires ZMap
* Pirate population limit is scaled by galaxy size.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Deprecated pirate galaxy limit multiplier (always 100%) and vanilla limit.
* Add-Ons 1.3: insane mode increases spawns by 40% flat from hard mode (30% more compared to hard mode).
* also frequently called by ZH.Monitor
* Add-Ons 2.2: Base Jump Station and Jump Beacon limits are now hard-coded to 4 and 6 before galaxy-size and difficulty scaling.
* Start scaling. (Add-Ons 1.9.1: Fixed scaling - now applies here. with jump point limit. We divide by 400 to keep the precision within 1 calculation.
* Insane difficulty reduces caps by 25%.
* If we're less than the base minimums, clamp again.
* Add-Ons 1.9.5c: Fix thresholds for insane mode.
* Add-Ons 2.0: Jump Hole Generator cap is equal to enumerated galaxy size + 1.
* Add-Ons 1.7.4: Handle grace radius here. Default: 3.
* Difficulty influences grace radius (bounded between 0-3). Easy: 3 normal: -1 sector (3 -> 2); hard and up: 0 (no grace radius).
* Clamp again in case.
* we do this here so that our tutorial message for the first built factory does not show up when player opens mobile factory screen for the first time
